items.summary: Google spots an AI that can find and exploit software flaws on its own, no human needed.

items.title: Live updates: Bitcoin stuck near $65,000 as popular 'basis trade' returns dry up
items.summary: XRP edged toward $1 and SOL rose 3%, while a Talos report showed crypto’s favorite carry trade now pays about what Treasuries do.

items.title: U.S. judge says Ethereum has ‘no terms of use,’ clears MIT brothers of $25 million fraud
items.summary: A federal judge acquitted Anton and James Peraire-Bueno, ruling that their 2023 trade against Ethereum trading bots involved no lie that anyone relied on, and closing the U.S. government’s first criminal case over the pr

items.title: Bitcoin's 12% slide through key support looks scary, but history says give it 3 months.
items.summary: Bitcoin broke below its 200-week average with a 12% drop. Only three similar crashes have occurred since 2013. Here’s what happened next.

items.title: XRP whales moved $270 million during the selloff. The coins didn’t go to exchanges
items.summary: A holder whose wallets trace back to a 2020 Bitstamp withdrawal has moved 281 million XRP into two vaults three weeks apart, a behavior indicative of custody rather than a large investor heading for the exit.

items.title: CFTC nominee questions public benefit of prediction markets as legal fight grows
items.summary: One of the two picks to join the regulatory commission, Democratic nominee Matthew Rowland, said he hopes to have a say in prediction markets rulemaking.

items.title: Nvidia shares rise on earnings beat, raised outlook despite leadership uncertainty
items.summary: Speaking on the earnings call, Chairman Harvey Jones said the board has no intention of reinstating Jensen Huang as CEO.

items.title: Coinbase CEO says AI agents will account for '99.9%' of transactions within a decade
items.summary: Brian Armstrong says Coinbase is building payment tools for AI agents and believes bitcoin has hit bottom despite the selloff.

items.title: Predictions platform Kalshi complies with order to halt Trump mention contracts
items.summary: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission ordered it to stop "mention" contracts involving the U.S. president and is reviewing whether Kalshi followed policy.

items.title: Druckenmiller says he is short copper, warns of economic weakness in 2027
items.summary: The billionaire investor is prioritizing capital preservation and shifting his AI focus from infrastructure to applications.

items.title: SOL comes out of Breakpoint 7% higher as Solana exits beta
items.summary: Solana’s token reached $75.12 on Tuesday, outpacing Bitcoin and Ether after the network retired the beta label it had used since its 2020 launch.

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs lose $240M as CryptoQuant flags bearish market phase
items.summary: Bitcoin ETF outflows returned after a one-day pause as CryptoQuant warned that Bitcoin had returned to a bearish market phase.

items.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
items.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

items.title: Ledger hardware implant saga reaches Dubai’s Virgin Megastore
items.summary: Two Ledger owners reported losing a combined $604,000 in crypto from hardware wallets they said were purchased at authorized retailer Virgin Megastore in Dubai.

items.title: Nvidia board rejects Huang comeback despite record $116B quarter
items.summary: Nvidia beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations by 5.6% and issued a stronger-than-expected sales forecast, while its board resisted growing calls for Jensen Huang’s reinstatement.

items.title: CFTC halts some Kalshi Trump mention markets over manipulation concerns
items.summary: The CFTC stayed Kalshi’s Trump-related mention markets after raising concerns about manipulation risks, giving the platform until Dec. 11 to defend its contracts.

items.title: Maple Finance CEO targets up to $15B in assets by the end of 2027
items.summary: Sidney Powell aims to reach $15 billion in assets under management by the end of 2027 as the firm looks to expand into tokenized lending and traditional finance.

items.title: Eastern Europe crypto flows fall 7.9% as Ukraine draws $12B in stablecoins
items.summary: Chainalysis found that Eastern Europe recorded the steepest decline in crypto activity of any region, while cross-border stablecoin transfers to Ukraine continued amid the ongoing war.

items.title: Lighter incident exposes risks beyond withdrawal controls
items.summary: Crypto platforms need enforceable limits on every route an API key can use to transfer value, including trades, internal transfers and shared pools.

items.title: Fed’s Waller cites Binance hack in warning over tokenized finance
items.summary: Fed Governor Christopher Waller questioned who bears responsibility for fraud, compromised keys and failed transactions as traditional financial assets move onto blockchains.

items.title: Why Microsoft Thinks Smaller, Cheaper AI Can Beat Claude and GPT
items.summary: Microsoft's new coding, cybersecurity and image models challenge bigger rivals on performance and price. The company's bet is that doing one job exceptionally well matters more than doing absolutely everything.

items.title: Nvidia Board Shuts Down Jensen Huang Comeback, Launches Search for New CEO
items.summary: Nvidia's board rejected a comeback for its ousted co-founder as it hired a search firm, backed interim CEO Colette Kress, and tightened oversight of chip exports to China.

items.title: Nvidia Shares Rise After Earnings Beat in First Report Since Jensen Huang's Exit
items.summary: The chipmaker doubled quarterly revenue, forecast another record and rallied after hours, but its first report without Jensen Huang leaves leadership questions and a deeply bruised stock chart unresolved.

items.title: OpenAI's GPT 6.2 Astra Challenges Anthropic on Price, But Not Every Benchmark
items.summary: OpenAI's latest models promise better professional work for less money, as the company battles Anthropic and Google for AI supremacy and faces tougher questions about increasingly capable systems and safety.

items.title: World Bank Taps Circle and Citi to Test Stablecoins for Development Payments
items.summary: The institution will test whether Circle’s USDC and blockchain rails can speed up and cut the cost of disbursing development funds.

items.title: Bitcoin Investors Are Capitulating—That’s Historically Been a Bottom Signal
items.summary: Glassnode says Bitcoin’s realized losses have reached levels seen only near the 2018, 2020, 2022 and early 2023 lows, as buyers defend the $62,000 to $66,000 range.

items.title: Cathie Wood's ARK Sells $85 Million in Nvidia, Buys $40 Million in Crypto Stocks
items.summary: Cathie Wood's funds trimmed Nvidia ahead of earnings while buying Block, Circle and Coinbase during Monday's selloff.

items.title: Ethereum Devs Weigh a Scaling Upgrade That Could Break 15,000 Apps
items.summary: Developers warned on a core dev call that two scaling changes in the Glamsterdam upgrade break assumptions some contracts rely on—pitting a 3.3x capacity boost against the risk of disrupting thousands of apps.

items.title: Jensen Huang Says He'd Be 'Honored' to Return as Nvidia CEO, Despite Board's Resistance
items.summary: The ousted Nvidia founder apologized for his conduct, offered to return if directors ask, and addressed supporters as the chipmaker presses ahead with its search for new leadership this week.

items.title: Binance Hack Wallets Move $137 Million in Ethereum After Two Weeks of Silence
items.summary: A wallet linked to October’s record Binance theft moved $63 million in ether, before analysts flagged a larger wave of transfers and reported Bitcoin swaps amid ongoing U.S. recovery efforts.
